profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer at Athene USA

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: ETL With C# and Python. WPF applications. SSRS, SQL, Web Development, JavaScript

positions.title: Contract Software Developer
positions.description: Back end developer on a large crop management application. I'm responsible for coding REST services called by another application. Also responsible for writing and maintaining unit tests.

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer
positions.description:
Maintain and modify websites using Microsoft development stack.

Developed a multi-tenant, multi-lingual content management system to replace a legacy system and to serve new international clients. This system makes heavy use of AJAX with a service-oriented architecture to support a high level of branding and customization. This system also features a custom templating engine based on PostScript.

Developed REST based API’s to integrate with third parties systems.

Created a windows service to generate PDF reports based on print requests submitted via a web application.

Interview potential employees and provide training and technical assistance to team members.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
.Net Development. C#, VB, TSQL, Javascript, SSRS. Web, Desktop, Web Services.

Tech lead on a proprietary events management system. This system manages travel, venue, accommodations, and entertainment for group events such as conferences or incentive travel. These programs generate approximately $240 million in annual revenue.  

Collaborate with third party vendors to exchange information via web services or other means. Some of these vendors provide on-site electronic services such as participant registration or mobile software.

Provide mentoring and technical support to new developers. Participate in the interviewing and vetting of potential employees.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Converted legacy ColdFusion systems to C#/ASP.Net.

Built and maintained websites for the insurance, education, and mortgage divisions of IBA, as well as several other associations. Bank employees throughout the Midwest are able to manage their employee benefits, lock and manage mortgages, sign up for training events, or receive legal advice. Some of these services are paid for via credit card.

Build several desktop applications. Build web-services and utilities to integrate the various software packages used by our mortgage division.

Helped move many of our manual/paper operations to the web, saving $36,000 in postage annually. 

Led conversion of legacy Crystal Reports to Microsoft SQL Server reporting services.

Led a successful effort to migrate department source code control to Team Foundation Server.

Provide mentoring, training, and assistance to less-experienced developers. Provide technical support and training to other departments and external customers.

Track industry trends via the Internet, seminars, and trade journals.  Recommended purchases and advised on strategies and workflow issues.

Responsible for understanding and implementing security measures on our web sites.

positions.title: IT Analyst
positions.description:
Primarily responsible for creating and maintaining web based systems for both internal and external clients using either Adobe Cold Fusion or PHP.

Develop databases using Microsoft SQL Server and MySQL 5.1.

Make use of JavaScript, Ajax, and CSS along with design skill to produce rich and intuitive interfaces.

Developed a Palm based application for conducting door-to-door surveys using NS Basic.

Meet with clients to determine their needs and to suggest possible solutions.

Assist other developers by introducing them to new technologies and concepts.
